Embed width $V$ at offset $o$ in width $W$. Let prefixes and bounded source functions $f,g$ satisfy the source and box cutoff bounds, including each prefix cardinality plus box cutoff fitting the source cutoff. Suppose all source stages are stored, the box slab precedes mask scratch, and the exact helper, space, word, product, and depth bounds hold. Procedure 28 constructs every box stage of the signed suffix leaf-weight function, retains both original source-stage families, and modifies only its box and scratch regions within the stated time.
